en: Job 11

p.src: 1  Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

en: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
u.src: 1  Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

p.src: 2  “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

ja: が、答えも受けずに済むのか。 口達者な者が
en: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
u.src: 2  “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

p.src: 3  Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

ja: るのか。 あなたがあざけっても、誰も
en: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
u.src: 3  Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

p.src: 4  For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

en: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
u.src: 4  For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

p.src: 5  But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
u.src: 5  But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

p.src: 6  that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

ja: してくださったらよいのに。 まことに、知恵には二つの面がある。
en: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
u.src: 6  that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

p.src: 7  “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

ja: の奥義を推し量ることができるか。
の限界を見極めることができるか。
en: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
u.src: 7  “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

p.src: 8  They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

ja: ができようか。 よみ よりも
い。あなたはどんなことを知り得ようか。
en: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
u.src: 8  They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

ja: 11:8 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 11:8 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 9  Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

en: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
u.src: 9  Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

p.src: 10  If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

ja: ぎ、あるいは閉じ込め、 あるいは法廷を開かれるなら、誰が神に逆らうことができようか。
en: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
u.src: 10  If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

p.src: 11  For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

ja: ごすことなく、不義を見抜く。
en: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
u.src: 11  For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

p.src: 12  An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

en: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
u.src: 12  An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

p.src: 13  “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

en: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
u.src: 13  “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

p.src: 14  If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

ja: ざけよ。 不正をあなたの
en: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
u.src: 14  If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

p.src: 15  Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

ja: そうすれば確かに、あなたは
げ、 そうだ、あなたは
en: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
u.src: 15  Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

p.src: 16  for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

en: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
u.src: 16  for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

p.src: 17  Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

en: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
u.src: 17  Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

p.src: 18  You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

ja: らかにいられる。 そうだ、あなたは見回し、
en: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
u.src: 18  You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

p.src: 19  Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

ja: たわっても、誰にも脅かされない。 そうだ、
en: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
u.src: 19  Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

p.src: 20  But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

ja: がなくなり、 彼らの希
en: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
u.src: 20  But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
